text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Property Standards Committee for a term of office ending October 12, 2027 and until successors are appointed: North York Panel: William Dolan Scarborough Panel: Alisa Chaplick
